instruction: How to create multiple views for internal/external DNS
output: echo 'view "internal" { match-clients { 10.0.0.0/8; }; zone "example.com" { type master; file "/etc/bind/db.example.com.internal"; }; };' >> /etc/bind/named.conf

instruction: How to set up DNS over TLS in BIND
output: echo 'options { listen-on port 853 tls mytls { any; }; };' >> /etc/bind/named.conf.options
